en.headline: Man robs Yau Ma Tei convenience store with brick, flees with cash
en.dek: Police are hunting a man in his 50s who threatened a female staff member at a Jordan Road shop around 4am on Monday and took several thousand dollars.
body: A man in his 50s robbed a convenience store in Yau Ma Tei early on Monday morning by threatening a female staff member with a brick and taking cash from the register before fleeing, police said.

Officers received a report at about 4:30am from the staff member at a shop at 9 Jordan Road. The suspect entered the premises holding a brick, demanded money, and left with several thousand Hong Kong dollars toward Gascoigne Road. No one was injured.
Police classified the case as robbery and are searching for the suspect. Investigations continue, and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 油麻地便利店遭男子持磚行劫 奪數千元現金逃去
zh.dek: 一名五十多歲男子周一凌晨約四時半闖入佐敦道便利店，以磚頭威脅女職員從收銀機取走數千元現金後逃逸，警方正追緝。
body: 警方表示，周一凌晨約四時半，一名約五十多歲男子持磚頭闖入油麻地佐敦道9號一間便利店，威脅女職員交出收銀機內現金，得手後向加士居道方向逃去。
事件中無人受傷。警方接報到場調查，將案件列作行劫，正追緝涉案男子，暫未有人被捕。
警方呼籲市民如有任何線索，請儘快聯絡警方協助調查。
